reuse.why: Consolidates the existing hidden-category query that three actions repeated into one helper, though copyPreviousMonth runs a second query for eligible ids instead of reusing the hidden/group_hidden data getBudgetData already joins.

duplication.why: Removes three copies of the category query and one inline hidden check, leaving a single selection definition.

placement.why: The selection helper sits in budget/actions.ts next to the month-wide actions that use it.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and their tests are touched; single-category actions are unchanged.

maintainability.why: One documented function decides which categories month-wide actions may write, so future exclusions are added once.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) use getMonthWideBudgetCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: Repeated queries were replaced by one helper rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: getMonthWideBudgetCategories in server/budget/actions.ts holds the hidden/group-hidden/template exclusion, used by every month-wide action.
